DOR.AML.REC.19/14.01.001/2025-26

12.06.2025

All Regulated Entities

Dear Sir / Madam,

Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Directions, 2025 - Amendment

1. Please refer to the Master Direction on Know Your Customer (KYC) issued by the Reserve Bank. With a view to simplifying the periodic updation of KYC, the following amendments are being made.

Chapter II - Customer Due Diligence

2. Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once in every two years for high risk customers, once in every eight years for medium risk customers and once in every ten years for low risk customers.

3. Regulated Entities shall send at least three advance intimations, including at least one by letter, to customers for complying with KYC updation requirements prior to the due date.

Chapter III - Account Freezing

4. Accounts shall not be frozen merely because periodic updation is pending, where the customer has submitted a self-declaration through any of the permitted channels including the Business Correspondent network.

5. These amendments shall come into force with effect from 1st August, 2025.

Yours faithfully,

(Veena Srinivasan)
Chief General Manager-in-Charge
